Magnitude 5.5 Earthquake Strikes Leh, Ladakh

A magnitude 5.5 earthquake struck Leh, Ladakh, on Thursday morning at 6:05 am. The tremors were felt across the region. The National Center for Seismology reported the earthquake occurred at a depth of 10 kilometers. No casualties have been reported.
